last_checked.note: 2026-09-03 check: v6.0.0.33 (tag created 2026-09-02T19:20:50Z, commit 014b4fa9 dated 2026-09-02T17:55:38Z) vs prior-checked v6.1.0.6 (2026-08-27). Two intermediate releases (v6.0.0.31 2026-08-26, v6.0.0.32 2026-09-01, v6.1.0.7 2026-09-01) shipped between checks and were skipped per the skill's 'pick the most recent tag' rule -- note the release list interleaves two parallel tracks (v6.0.0.x = broad/stable, v6.1.0.x = narrower rollout); this run picked whichever tag has the latest created_at regardless of track, consistent with prior runs. Queried 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z (day before commit date) to now, a ~2.5-day window. Used logs/analytics/aggregate (group_by status) for exact totals: info:3,322,297 warn:796,617 error:1,507,155 critical:54 (plus ok:1,467,065 debug:45 notice:29,631, not tracked in status_summary schema). Rollout confirmed across 18 clusters via group_by cluster_name (full census, not a sample): production x4 (us1a, us2a, eu5a, ap1a -- us2a/eu5a/us1a each >1.7M logs, the bulk of volume), staging x2 (eu5a, us1a), 12 customer MPC/GCP clusters. This is ~26x the log volume of the prior v6.1.0.6 check, consistent with v6.0.0.x being the much more broadly deployed track -- raw counts are not directly comparable to the prior run. CRITICAL (54, up from 0): all 54 are 'WORKER TIMEOUT (pid:N)' on production-aws-eu5a -- exact match to existing known_noise entry 'WORKER TIMEOUT (pid:', not a new issue. ERROR (1,507,155, up from 723 -- both in raw count AND as a share of total logs, 21.2% vs 0.26% previously): NEW dominant pattern, NOT in known_noise and NOT added pending investigation: 'Error getting treatment for feature' (542,518) + 'Error reporting impression into get_treatment exception block' (542,455) = 1,084,973 combined, 72% of all error-status logs. Traced via full event attributes to module=client, filename=client.py:123, funcName=_make_evaluation -- this is the Split.io feature-flag SDK client failing on essentially every treatment evaluation. Concentrated in production-aws-us2a (859,779 errors) and production-aws-eu5a (399,657); ap1a and customer MPC clusters barely affected (<2,500 each), suggesting a connectivity/config issue specific to those two clusters' Split.io SDK setup rather than an app-wide regression. Flagged as NEEDS ATTENTION -- recommend checking Split.io SDK key/connectivity config for production-aws-us2a and production-aws-eu5a, and whether feature-flag evaluation failures are silently defaulting (fail-open/fail-closed) in a way that affects user-facing behavior. Secondary new-volume pattern (63,903 occurrences, NOT added to known_noise pending next-run comparison): 'Error upserting user <id>' -- many distinct low-count user IDs, no single ID dominates, likely a batch/sync job issue rather than one bad record. Remainder of errors (~354K after excluding the above) sampled via time-recent 1000-event slices and found to be dominated by existing known_noise (authlib deprecation stack fragments, SSL connection closed, alert-query failures) plus long-tail one-off 'Error handling request POST /api/v1/chart/data' entries for dashboard_id=48 across many slice_ids, low count each, likely a flaky/slow dashboard rather than systemic. WARN (796,617) and INFO (3,322,297) not exhaustively broken down this run given the ERROR-status finding was the clear headline; spot checks found no new dominant WARN pattern (the previously-added 'Session-invalidation check failed; allowing request' returned 0 matches for this SHA -- module may not be firing the same way on this build/track). known_noise list carried forward unchanged (48 patterns) -- none of this run's new findings met the bar for suppression.
